title: When is a ball 'in the bunker'?
question: Your ball comes to rest on the border between the sand and some grass that's inside the edge of the bunker. When is your ball officially classed as 'in the bunker'?

choices.text: Only if the whole ball is inside the sand area
If any part of the ball touches the sand in the bunker
If the ball is fully on grass even if inside the edge
Any time the ball is within the boundary, even if not touching sand

explanation: The ball is classed as being in the bunker if any part of it touches sand inside the edge of the bunker, no matter where the rest of the ball lies.
